scripts.check:unused-members: pnpm exec fallow dead-code --unused-class-members --type-aware --type-aware-project tsconfig.json --format compact --no-cache
scripts.check:duplicates: pnpm exec jscpd --min-lines 20 --min-tokens 60 --reporters console --exit-code 1 --no-colors --no-tips --format typescript --ignore '**/*.test.ts' src
scripts.test:quality: QUALITY_PROFILE=smoke pnpm exec vitest run test/quality/cases.test.ts test/quality/shards
scripts.test:quality:full: QUALITY_PROFILE=full pnpm exec vitest run test/quality/cases.test.ts test/quality/shards
scripts.test:quality:update: pnpm run quality:update:generate && pnpm run quality:update:apply
scripts.quality:update:generate: rm -rf tmp/quality-baseline-update && UPDATE_QUALITY_BASELINE=1 QUALITY_PROFILE=full pnpm exec vitest run test/quality/shards
scripts.quality:update:apply: UPDATE_QUALITY_BASELINE=1 QUALITY_PROFILE=full pnpm exec vitest run test/quality/cases.test.ts
scripts.quality:targets:init: INIT_QUALITY_TARGETS=1 pnpm exec vitest run test/quality/targets.test.ts
scripts.test:quality:report: pnpm run quality:report:cases && pnpm run quality:report:aggregate
scripts.quality:report:cases: rm -rf tmp/quality-report/latest tmp/quality-report/partial && QUALITY_REPORT=1 QUALITY_PROFILE=full pnpm exec vitest run test/quality/shards
scripts.quality:report-and-gate:cases: rm -rf tmp/quality-report/latest tmp/quality-report/partial tmp/quality-gate-warnings && QUALITY_REPORT=1 QUALITY_GATE=1 QUALITY_PROFILE=full pnpm exec vitest run test/quality/shards
scripts.quality:report:aggregate: QUALITY_REPORT=1 QUALITY_PROFILE=full pnpm exec vitest run test/quality/report.test.ts --reporter=default --reporter=./test/quality/quality-reporter.ts
